input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the volume of air served by scrubber-1-v9 in the Lab, by V = Qe * tau, with the 3 present occupants as CO2 source.

steps.why: Rise: reduced effective flow 0.4 m3/min (datasheet minimum elevated speed); with 3 occupants (1.14 L/min) equilibrium is about 2960 ppm but the step stops at 20 min, well under tau (about 75 min for V=30 m3), expected end about 1650 ppm (about 2200 ppm if V=10 m3).
Decay: full speed, Qe = 1 m3/min, back towards the full-speed equilibrium (about 1250 ppm); 30 min is about one tau for V=30 m3. Total 50 min, under the 55 min bound.

abort.when: the Lab CO2 is at or above 3000 ppm at any sample
the device refuses a step's command
a monitored person leaves the 45 to 120 bpm band, monitoring is lost, or one more person enters the Lab

monitoring.reason: The test raises the CO2 of the air breathed by the three occupants of the Lab.

hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone.

The hatch to Hab-B (1 occupant, CDR) is held closed during both steps; the exchange through the closed hatch is not measured (the design ventilation with the hatch closed is 3 m3/min per station-topology, hypothesis) and Hab-B CO2 is recorded to show whether the opening exchanges air.
The 3 occupants stay at awake activity (0.38 L/min each, 1.14 L/min total), constant during the test; none enters or leaves.
Effective flow Qe = 1 m3/min x speed/100 (datasheet, efficiency 0.3), with a 3.33 min scrubber lag not fitted out of tau.
The initial guess V=30 m3 is only a guess for sizing durations; the fit C(t)=C_eq+(C0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) gives tau and V = Qe*tau.

expected.rise: Lab CO2 climbs from about 1250 ppm to about 1650 ppm after 20 min at 40 percent (V=30 m3); about 2200 ppm if V=10 m3; never above 2500 ppm. A rise above 2500 ppm means a smaller volume, a leak or an extra source.
expected.decay: After returning to 100 percent, CO2 falls exponentially towards about 1250 ppm with tau about 30 min if V=30 m3 (tau = V/1 m3/min); V_lab = 1 m3/min x fitted tau.
expected.hab_b: Hab-B CO2 stays flat if the closed hatch exchanges little air; a drift that follows the Lab shows exchange and invalidates the one-zone hypothesis.
expected.not_held: Non-exponential curve, tau inconsistent between phases, or a changed occupant count would show the hypotheses do not hold.
